purpose: Source-semantic rulings after independent metadata audit, not changes to numerical thresholds or result-based cohort selection
SICdb_age: The frozen encoded AgeOnAdmission>=25 cutoff is retained. Official release documentation does not establish that each encoded age is a true five-year-bin lower bound. Therefore the planned wording 'lower bound>=25' is NOT claimed fulfilled; SICdb is labelled source-encoded age cutoff, not exact age matching. No post-result cutoff adjustment.
MIMIC_age: Age is reconstructed from deidentified year-level metadata, with top coding; it is not exact birthday-based age. Confirmed eligible waveform records have verified year-level age>=25.
ICUOffset: First ICU/intermediate-care transfer. The after-assignment scenario requires complete origin-zero hours with>=48 valid minutes at/after that time, and excludes prior values from its display. It is not proof of uninterrupted ICU occupancy or surgery end.
surgical_groups: SICdb source-defined Elective Surgery and Urgent Surgery are grouped as surgical admission; No Surgery is separately described. MIMIC stable CSURG/SURG/NSURG/VSURG treating services define surgical-service context. These are source-specific descriptors, not equivalent surgical phenotypes or proof of postoperative timing.
postoperative: NO-GO for a generally applicable postoperative subgroup with verified surgery-end linkage. No diagnosis keyword or billed date is promoted to surgery time.
paired_patient_equal: Minute-minus-native patient-equal differences use the intersection of patients with the metric defined at both resolutions; the pooled contrast uses the same full patient set. Do not fill zero-event ratios with zero.
scope: These rulings are documented before computing the new subgroup effects. All original sources and the manuscript remain unchanged.
